The April 2023 DINOv2 excerpt documents use of a ViT-g model and distillation into smaller models, but the quoted passage does not establish benchmark leadership [e2].
limitations: Individual systems do not establish transformer prevalence across whole fields or how many tasks used transformers little or not at all.

Game playing, scientific applications and the remaining forms of reasoning are not settled by this packet.
The current Ragnarok abstract includes later analysis, and its exact posting date is unknown; the official results establish the July 11, 2023, competition announcement [e3, e4].

our_interpretation: Little to no use means transformers are absent or peripheral in leading systems for the named task areas.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Transformer components play central roles in leading systems across the named areas. A central transformer in a leading system contradicts the characterization for that example, without proving universal transformer adoption.
